### FaceTriangulator { #fieldadapters-kt-facetriangulator }

<code class="highlight"><span class="k">fun</span> <span class="k">interface</span> <span class="nc">FaceTriangulator</span></code>

Polygon triangulation strategy. Input and output values are indices into [`Realization3`](uncategorised.md#solids-kt-realization3), not global [`ElementId`](uncategorised.md#topology-kt-elementid) values or render-buffer offsets. Implementations must return consecutive triples and may only reference vertices present in the supplied face.
